arguments.text: Implemented and locally verified evaluate(request,evidence,policy): missing required request conditions return sorted unknown names; eligibility requires matching claim, non-withdrawn status, optional verification, and equality for every policy-required condition; only eligible superseders remove source IDs; no retained evidence is unknown; canonical JSON disagreement is conflict without majority voting; agreement returns supported except literal false returns unsupported; inputs remain unchanged. Current report.json exactly matches evaluation of requests.json with evidence.json and policy.json.

Unresolved limits: source IDs and required-condition names are assumed sortable strings, evidence records are assumed to carry source IDs, and values are assumed valid finite JSON values. Canonical comparison uses deterministic Python JSON serialization (sorted object keys); behavior for non-JSON Python objects, NaN/infinity, or alternate numeric spellings such as 1 versus 1.0 is outside tested conditions.
